actual_tools: RCSB PDB 4AKE and 1AKE with local Python NumPy Kabsch analysis
execution.implementation: Genuine Rosalind task-chooser observation plus digest-verified local coordinate comparison of open and AP5-bound adenylate kinase

observations: Both retained chain-A structures provide 214 matched C-alpha atoms and 1AKE contains AP5.
The local all-correspondence Kabsch RMSD is 7.130700 angstrom.
CORE-to-NMP and CORE-to-LID centroid distances are shorter in AP5-bound 1AKE than in open 4AKE.
A genuine Rosalind Workbench open call returned the exact task-chooser-ready message.
interpretation: The coordinate comparison illustrates a pronounced NMP and LID domain closure around the ligand-bound state.
limitations: The local Kabsch result is distinct from TM-align and does not measure affinity or dynamics.
Domain residue sets are explicit teaching definitions.
rosalind_open only opened the task chooser and did not run a structural analysis.

provenance.note: Pinned public coordinates and local NumPy support the structural measurements; the separate 914-byte Rosalind observation supports launcher readiness only.

reproduction: Run python showcases/rosalind-workbench/cases/rosalind-adenylate-kinase/build_case.py from the repository root.
Require both recorded source digests, 214 matched C-alpha atoms, AP5 presence, and stable output files.
Treat the Rosalind launcher receipt separately from the coordinate analysis.
